<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at 1.36.0 -->

## What's Changed
### Breaking Changes 🛠
* Remove legacy caching logic by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8737
* Deprecate the `experimental_allow_widgets` caching parameter by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8817
### New Features 🎉
* Allow passing on_change_callback for CustomComponents by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8633
* Use raw number for number column overlay and copy by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8708
* Introduce st.navigation and st.Page by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8744
* Make st.write call st.json to display Streamlit secrets object by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8659
* Streamlit Charts: Customizable Axis Labels by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8846
* Add vertical alignment parameter to `st.columns` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8568
* Add `icon` parameter to st.expander by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8716
* Use the default widget height for non-stacked checkbox & toggle widgets by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8835
* Horizontal `st.bar_chart` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8877
### Bug Fixes 🐛
* Remove non-existent kwargs in ast.Call() call by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8711
* Don't instantiate the LocalSourcesWatcher if file watching is disabled by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8741
* Make the session state writes disallowed message more generic by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8720
* Ensure SessionInfo is set before performing an action by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8779
* Unify the minimum height of most element  by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8797
* Don't allow writing widgets outside the fragment by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8756
* Fix element replay regression for plotly charts by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8770
* Improve exception text when selectbox index larger than options by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8775
* Prevent images in markdown to go beyond the container width by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8794
* Ensure current page script hash and active script hash is correct at script start by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8830
* Revert "Handle Altair resolve_scale (#8497)" by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8845
* Update custom-components import paths and tests by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8666
* Raise exception if st.Page is given an invalid path by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8878
### Other Changes
* Explicitly export experimental_dialog by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8728
* Remove default value for title of dialog_decorator by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8729
* Docstrings for 1.35.0 (and type consistency for charts) by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8740
* Migrate streamlit hello to MPAv2 by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8806
* Fix `use_container_width` docstring when default is `True` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8809
* Allow protobuf v5 as dependency by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8627
* Fix: Remove title appending · Streamlit  by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8900

## New Contributors
* [USER] made their first contribution in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8711

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/compare/1.35.0...1.36.0
